description: Docs bug in getCrawl's response, observed on the wire (reported in #331 by @k3dom, who had been running it as a `pnpm patch` in production): the response `cursor` is documented as a string but is returned as a number — the next record index for pagination, absent on the last page. (The REQUEST cursor is already correctly typed as a number upstream.) The companion fix — `records[].metadata` documented as required although Cloudflare omits it for records that have not completed — is now correct upstream, so that op is gone.
